description: This Java class 'IncomingSignal' serves as an immutable wrapper for the 'Signal' object, marking it as an incoming signal within the streaming service of the Eclipse Ditto gateway. It provides static factory methods for creation, accessors, and overrides for 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString' methods.

classes.description: Immutable wrapper class for marking a 'Signal' object as an incoming signal in the streaming context.
